```{python}
#| label: pysetup
import scripts.moderncv as cv
import yaml

with open("_contents.yml", "r") as f:
  contents = yaml.safe_load(f)
```

### {{< meta publications.peer-reviewed.cv-subheader >}}

```{python}
#| label: peer-review
#| output: asis

        cv.mdlist(items=contents['publications']['peer-reviewed']['items'], bullets=False)
```
